83K likes, 339 comments - foodie_mette on August 22, 2026: "Piri Piri Chicken with Yellow Rice & grilled corn🇵🇹🇲🇿 A delicious Portuguese-Mozambican classic - juicy, smoky and spicy piri-piri chicken served with fluffy yellow rice and charred grilled corn. You gotta try this!!!

INGREDIENTS
PIRI PIRI CHICKEN + MARINADE
• 700 g bone-in, skin-on chicken leg quarters
• 5–6 fresh bird’s eye chillies (8–10 Fresno for milder heat)
• 5–6 garlic cloves
• 1½ tbsp smoked paprika
• 1 tbsp sweet paprika
• 1 tsp oregano
• 1 tsp thyme
• ½ tsp cumin
• 1½ tsp salt
• 2 tbsp honey
• Juice + zest of 1 lemon
• 2 tbsp red wine vinegar
• 100 ml extra-virgin olive oil
• 1 roasted bell pepper

YELLOW RICE
• 300 g long-grain basmati rice
• 450 ml chicken stock
• 1 tbsp butter + a little olive oil
• 1 small onion, finely diced
• 2 garlic cloves, minced
• 1 tsp turmeric
• ½ tsp smoked paprika
• 1 bay leaf
• ½ tsp black pepper
• Salt to taste

TO SERVE
• 3–4 corn cobs
• Fresh parsley or coriander
• Lemon wedges

METHOD

1. Make the sauce: Blend all piri-piri ingredients until smooth. Before adding the chicken, set aside a generous portion in a clean bowl/jar for serving.
2. Marinate: Coat the leg quarters well with the remaining sauce. Marinate for at least 30 min, ideally overnight.
3. Rice: Rinse rice well. Sauté onion in butter + olive oil for 4–5 min. Add garlic, turmeric and paprika; cook 30 sec. Add rice and stir for 1–2 min.
4. Add chicken stock, bay leaf, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 12 min. Turn off heat and leave covered for 10 min. Remove bay leaf and fluff.
5. Chicken: Bake on a rack over a tray at 200°C / 400°F fan for about 40–50 min, turning halfway if needed, until cooked through. Grill/broil for the last 3–5 min for extra char.
6. Corn: Grill until tender and nicely charred, turning occasionally.
7. Rest the chicken for 5–10 min. Serve with yellow rice and grilled corn. Drizzle with the reserved piri-piri sauce and finish with fresh herbs + lemon. Enjooy 🫶
#dinnerinspo #mealinspo #dinnerideasُ".
